canaries.description: Raw string interpolation into a SQL query instead of a parameterized query
canaries.buggy_snippet: const rows = await db.query(`SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = '${email}'`);
canaries.clean_snippet: const rows = await db.query('SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = $1', [email]);

canaries.description: A query missing a tenant/org scoping clause — DEFECT_DISCIPLINE.md's own illustrative Rule 1 example
canaries.buggy_snippet: const patient = await db.patient.findUnique({ where: { id: patientId } });
canaries.clean_snippet: const patient = await db.patient.findUnique({ where: { id: patientId, tenantId: ctx.tenantId } });

canaries.description: A query inside a loop instead of a single batched fetch
canaries.buggy_snippet: for (const order of orders) { order.customer = await db.customer.findUnique({ where: { id: order.customerId } }); }
canaries.clean_snippet: const customerIds = orders.map(o => o.customerId); const customers = await db.customer.findMany({ where: { id: { in: customerIds } } }); const byId = Object.fromEntries(customers.map(c => [c.id, c]));

canaries.class: race condition — check-then-write on shared state
canaries.description: A balance check followed by a separate write, with a gap an interleaved request can exploit — DEFECT_DISCIPLINE.md Rule 3's exact illustrative shape
canaries.buggy_snippet: const account = await db.account.findUnique({ where: { id } }); if (account.balance >= amount) { await db.account.update({ where: { id }, data: { balance: account.balance - amount } }); }
canaries.clean_snippet: await db.account.updateMany({ where: { id, balance: { gte: amount } }, data: { balance: { decrement: amount } } });
